notes: family matches the material field in products.json, so any filament in that family can print the product. Stats are 1 to 5. Prices are per spool (1 kg) or per litre for resin. Brands are parody names.

materials.name: PLA Basic
materials.notes: The starter. Cheap, easy, comes in every colour.

materials.name: PLA Matte
materials.notes: Hides layer lines. Popular for decor and figurines.

materials.name: PLA+ Tough
materials.notes: Tougher PLA, fewer snapped parts in the post.

materials.name: Silk PLA
materials.notes: Shiny metallic look. Premium cosmetic prints sell higher.

materials.name: Marble PLA
materials.notes: Stone speckle effect for vases and busts.

materials.name: Sparkle PLA
materials.notes: Glitter flecks. Kids and gift products.

materials.name: Translucent PLA
materials.notes: See-through for lamps and lithophanes.

materials.name: Glow in the Dark PLA
materials.notes: Abrasive. Chews through brass nozzles fast.

materials.name: Wood Fill PLA
materials.notes: Real wood fibres. Can clog small nozzles.

materials.name: Carbon Fibre PLA
materials.notes: Stiff and light. Abrasive.

materials.name: PETG Basic
materials.notes: Strong and outdoor friendly. Strings a lot.

materials.name: Translucent PETG
materials.notes: Glassy, tinted finish.

materials.name: Carbon Fibre PETG
materials.notes: Engineering grade functional parts.

materials.name: TPU 95A
materials.notes: Rubbery. Phone cases, grips, feet. Print slowly.

materials.name: TPU 85A Soft
materials.notes: Very squishy. Jams multicolour units.

materials.name: ABS
materials.notes: Heat resistant. Warps and smells without an enclosure.

materials.name: ASA
materials.notes: UV proof ABS. Best for outdoor parts.

materials.name: Polycarbonate
materials.notes: Very strong and heat resistant. Hard to print.

materials.name: Nylon PA
materials.notes: Tough and slippery. Soaks up moisture fast.

materials.name: Carbon Fibre Nylon
materials.notes: Top tier strength for B2B engineering jobs.

materials.name: PVA Support
materials.notes: Dissolves in water. Used as support for complex prints.

materials.name: HIPS Support
materials.notes: Breakaway support for ABS.

materials.name: Standard Resin
materials.requires: Resin printer, wash and cure station
materials.notes: Ultra fine detail for minis and jewellery. Sold per litre.

materials.name: Tough Resin
materials.requires: Resin printer, wash and cure station
materials.notes: Less brittle. Functional resin parts.

materials.name: Water Washable Resin
materials.requires: Resin printer, wash and cure station
materials.notes: Cleans up with water. Easier workflow.
